usage: The word 淺色 (cin2 sik1) is used to describe colors that are light or pale in shade.
You can use 淺色 to talk about clothes, backgrounds, or any objects with a light color tone.
It can appear before a noun to specify the color type, for example, 淺色衫 means light-colored shirt.
淺色 can also be contrasted with 深色 (sam1 sik1) which means dark color.
When shopping or describing outfits, 淺色 helps distinguish styles by color brightness.
